_comment: Dependency audit exceptions. Optional per-exception lockfile scopes to one audited lockfile root: '.' (repository root) or 'web' (web/ Kit workspace). An exception without lockfile applies to both lockfiles; an exception with lockfile applies only to that lockfile. See CONTRIBUTING.md dependency security section.

exceptions.reason: GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h is an MCP client-side OAuth credential leak (a client sends credentials to a server-chosen authorization server). This Worker imports only agents/mcp/server, the stateless server entry: it never instantiates an MCP client, performs no OAuth flow, and the /mcp endpoint takes no credentials (no session, no cookies, no auth), so the vulnerable client modules are unreachable from the shipped bundle. Accepted until Dependabot lands a fixed release; re-check at expiry. Reviewed in the stateless public MCP PR.

Same GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h client-side OAuth leak as the sdk entry above: server-only import, no client instantiation, no OAuth, no credentials on /mcp. Unreachable from the shipped bundle. Accepted until Dependabot lands a fixed release; re-check at expiry. Reviewed in the stateless public MCP PR.
